customMethods.name: deleteRouteEvent
customMethods.script:
if len(self.view.custom.routes.selectedData) == 0: return
	routeEventId = self.view.custom.routes.selectedData[0]['routeEventId']
	system.kanoa.lot.deleteRouteEvent(routeEventId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
	
	self.view.custom.routes.row = None
	self.view.custom.routes.col = None	
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.routes.data")	

	return
